_meta.catalog: WWF No Mercy CAW parts — Creation Suite catalog (registry-entry shape)
_meta.suite_slot_mapping: bodies: label keyword -> upper_body/lower_body (none => null); faces -> face; skins -> null (full-body textures); accessories -> accessory; attire -> attire
_meta.note: The 35 No Mercy entries already inside PARTS-REGISTRY.json point at these same files; catalogs.js dedupes by file path (registry wins, it carries bone/editable metadata).
